reviews.comment: He was a funny guy but this class sucked balls. He did very little workout problems and a ton of theoretical stuff that was hard to follow. The homeworks were also really hard, but the exams weren't that bad. This isn't a very hard class but I think this was his first semester teaching so he was still figuring stuff out.

Dr. McFarland cares but is extremely strict for senior design. Very critical for things that are so minimal in the grand scope of your project. Treats you like you know everything when in reality we're just seniors trying to finish our degree. Wasn't a fan.

Dr. McFarland is a very intelligent professor, but some concepts are very difficult to learn in his lectures. His homeworks are much harder than those from other professors, but they prepare you for the exams. In class, he initially posts incomplete lecture notes to ensure students pay attention and gives easy pop quizzes (as long as you keep up).
reviews.ratingTags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: McFarland was not the greatest prof for 344, as his lectures were very hard to follow and went too deep into theory that had little to do with what we were learning. He often had pop quizzes/assignments in class. The homework's were tedious and sometimes not very helpful, so I did my learning by going through the textbook and watching YouTube.
reviews.ratingTags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Goes way too deep into theory with little application. Boring & rambling clearly only interested in research. Also gives many graded impromptu quizzes and assignments. If he didn't have these in place, no one would show up. Homework is hard and preps you for exam, but in the end I learned from the textbook and youtube. Class only good for exam info
Pretty average. Class is hard and he spends most of it on theory you will never use, but ends up preparing you well for exams with extremely hard hw.

Dr. McFarland seems only into his research. He should be teaching a thermofluids graduate course if any. 
Bothered to be there, grading barely matches the rubric, hypercritical/very subjective when providing feedback, poor and uncaring body language, disrespectful through grading/in person comments. 
Atrocious role model for a student.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things
